| Help - Preflight                                                             |
|                                                                              |
| up/down     check                                                            |
| Tab         action                                                           |
| Enter       select                                                           |
| Esc         back                                                             |
| q           exit                                                             |
| ?/F1        help                                                             |
| Ctrl+C      exit                                                             |
|                                                                              |
| The checks are read-only: they never install software or change Docker, the  |
| kernel or a cluster. A fix is advice, or a change to the pending plan that   |
| runs the checks again; Recheck runs them again as they are. Continue is      |
| unavailable while any check fails. Nothing has been changed yet: nothing on  |
| these screens changes anything until you approve the plan on the review.     |
| Ctrl+C exits.                                                                |
|                                                                              |
|                                                                              |
|                                                                              |
|                                                                              |
